Definition: from G5064 and G757; the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch"):--tetrarch.
BiblicalUsage: tetrárchēs is the word the Bible uses when it means a tetrarch, ruler of a fourth part. In Matthew 14:1, At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus, and it appears again in Luke 3:19. In the Greek text the word is spelled τετραάρχης.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a ruler of a fourth part still answers to the God who rules the whole.
